faq.q: How much does Nouri Law charge?
faq.a: Nouri Law publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Nouri Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Nouri Law publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Nouri Law have offices?
faq.a: Nouri Law publishes one office, in El Cajon. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Nouri Law?
faq.a: Nouri Law names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Nouri Law?
faq.a: Nouri Law scores 41 and sits at Listed. Did not pass: website and footprint. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure, discipline and entity registration. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
